##### Project general facts

The Trees Residence by Anocha is an exclusive collection of hotel investment residences nestled in a lush tropical setting in Phuket, offering a private and peaceful lifestyle surrounded by forested mountain views. The development comprises 296 low-density units distributed across 17 buildings of 4–5 floors, designed in a villa-style concept to ensure space, privacy, and a strong connection to nature. The project offers well-planned 1-bedroom and 2-bedroom residences, combining contemporary comfort with a serene resort atmosphere, creating a perfect balance between investment potential and lifestyle living.

Residents enjoy a full range of five-star amenities designed for relaxation, wellness, and convenience. These include multiple swimming pools, a fully equipped fitness center, sauna, ice bath, hot and cold baths, spa and massage facilities, as well as landscaped courtyards and leisure areas. The development also features a café and restaurant, co-working spaces, library, kids’ playground and club, beauty salon, and outdoor theatre with BBQ areas, creating a complete resort-style living experience.

The residences are designed with modern layouts and efficient use of space, offering comfortable living areas. The project operates under a fully managed hotel concept, allowing owners to benefit from professional management and rental income potential. Finishing is modern with high-quality materials, equipped kitchens, and a turnkey format suited for both personal use and investment.


##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Located on the northwest coast of Phuket, Bang Tao is one of the island’s most sought-after coastal destinations, known for its long stretch of pristine beach and relaxed upscale atmosphere. The area is home to the renowned Laguna Phuket — a fully integrated resort community featuring luxury hotels, golf courses, spas, and high-end residences. Bang Tao Beach itself spans nearly 6 kilometers, offering a quieter alternative to the more vibrant tourist hubs while still maintaining a sophisticated lifestyle appeal.

The district is well-developed with a strong infrastructure, providing residents and visitors with easy access to lifestyle amenities. Within minutes, you’ll find premium dining venues, beach clubs, and shopping destinations such as Boat Avenue and Porto de Phuket. The area seamlessly blends leisure and convenience, with international schools, wellness centers, and supermarkets all nearby, making it ideal for both short-term stays and long-term living.

Bang Tao also benefits from excellent connectivity. Phuket International Airport is approximately a 20 minute drive away, ensuring easy international access. The project offers shuttle buses to the beach and key infrastructure points. Its strategic location allows quick connections to neighboring areas such as Surin and Kamala, while still preserving a sense of privacy and exclusivity — making Bang Tao a prime choice for investors and homeowners seeking a balance of tranquility and vibrant coastal living.
